# PAT scopes

> **AUTHENTICATION IS ENFORCED; AUTHORIZATION IS NOT YET.** An operation that names a credential requires one — an anonymous request is refused with `401`. What the server does not check yet is CAPABILITY: no permission is verified, scopes are not intersected with the service account's role, and the capability floor is documented rather than enforced. Until the authorization middleware lands, any live credential passes every operation. See "Known gaps" in SECURITY.md.

The 27 scopes a personal access token can carry. They are `<family>:<verb>`,
colon-separated, and this page is generated from `internal/authz/catalogue.go`
([canonical §6](../design/00-canonical-conventions.md)). The same list is published in the
OpenAPI document as `x-dkp-scopes` on the `pat` security scheme.

**Scopes are coarser than [permissions](permissions.md) on purpose:** a scope narrows a
token, a permission narrows a role. Effective capability is the intersection —
`role permissions ∩ token scopes` — so a token can only ever narrow what its service account
already has, and a scope on a token whose account lacks the matching permission grants
nothing.

| Scope | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `roster:read` | Read roster | Read the guild roster. |
| `roster:write` | Edit roster | Edit the guild roster. |
| `raids:read` | Read raids | Read raids and attendance. |
| `raids:write` | Write raids | Create and update raids and ticks. |
| `dkp:read` | Read points | Read standings and the ledger. |
| `dkp:adjust` | Adjust points | Create point adjustments. |
| `loot:read` | Read loot | Read the item catalogue and awards. |
| `loot:award` | Award loot | Record item awards. |
| `bids:read` | Read bids | Read bid sessions. |
| `bids:place` | Place bids | Place and retract bids in an open session, for the token owner's own accounts only. |
| `bids:manage` | Manage bids | Open, extend, close, resolve and settle bid sessions. |
| `logs:ingest` | Ingest logs | Submit parsed P99 log artefacts. |
| `calendar:read` | Read calendar | Read the raid calendar. |
| `calendar:write` | Write calendar | Create and edit calendar events. |
| `cms:read` | Read content | Read articles, media and policies. |
| `cms:write` | Write content | Author articles, media and policies. |
| `events:subscribe` | Subscribe to events | Subscribe to the realtime event stream. |
| `webhooks:manage` | Manage webhooks | Create, edit and delete webhooks. |
| `bank:read` | Read bank | Read the guild bank. |
| `bank:request` | Request from bank | Request an item from the bank, for the token owner's own accounts only. |
| `bank:manage` | Manage bank | Manage the guild bank's inventory and requests. |
| `draft:read` | Read drafts | Read draft weeks and ballots. |
| `draft:vote` | Vote in drafts | Submit a ranked ballot, for the token owner's own account only. |
| `recruit:read` | Read recruitment | Read recruitment applications. |
| `recruit:manage` | Manage recruitment | Comment on and decide recruitment applications. |
| `swap:read` | Read swaps | Read and quote main swaps, without committing one. |
| `swap:manage` | Manage swaps | Approve, deny and configure main swaps. |

## What no scope covers

Operations that alter authentication, authorization or bulk-export state have **no
scope at all** and are session-and-step-up only. See
[the capability floor](permissions.md#the-capability-floor) for the exact set of keys.
